Specifies files and directories for Git to ignore in the Python backend project.

# Purpose
The content specifies a `.gitignore` file used in a Git repository to exclude certain files and directories from being tracked by version control. It includes patterns to ignore Python bytecode files (`*.pyc`), cache directories (`__pycache__`, `.mypy_cache`, `.cache`), virtual environment directories (`.venv`), and coverage report files (`.coverage`, `htmlcov`). The `app.egg-info` directory is also excluded, which typically contains metadata about a Python package.
